description_en: Queries the historical deployment records of an edge instance
description_zh: 查询边缘实例历史部署记录
name: QueryEdgeInstanceHistoricDeployment

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. If you do not specify a time range, all historical deployment records of the instance are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间。如果不传入起止时间，则查询该实例的全部历史部署记录
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. If you do not specify a time range, all historical deployment records of the instance are queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。如果不传入起止时间，则查询该实例的全部历史部署记录
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The return code of the operation. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

DeploymentList.description_en: The list of edge instance deployments

DeploymentId.description_en: The ID of the deployment task

Description.description_en: The description of the deployment task

GmtCompleted.description_en: The time when the deployment task was completed

GmtCompletedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the deployment task was completed

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the deployment task was created

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the deployment task was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the deployment task was last updated
GmtModified.description_zh: 最后一次更新部署单的时间

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the deployment task was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新部署单的Unix时间戳

Status.description_en:
The status of the deployment task. Valid values:

0: not started (init).
1: in progress (processing).
2: succeeded (success).
3: failed (failure)
Status.description_zh:
实例的部署单状态。

0：未开始（init）。
1：正在进行中（processing）。
2：成功（success）。
3：失败（failure）

Type.description_en:
The type of the deployment task. Valid values:

deploy: deploy.
reset: reset
Type.description_zh:
部署单类型。

deploy：部署。
reset：重置

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful. A value of false indicates that the call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
